title: DISCOSENSE: Commonsense Reasoning with Discourse Connectives

bias_targets.methodology: Using Conditional Adversarial Filtering (CAF) to measure and mitigate models' reliance on unintended linguistic signals (e.g., lexical overlap/similarity). The methodology iteratively trains discriminator models to identify and replace easily solvable synthetic options, evaluating whether baseline language models exploit superficial cues rather than performing true commonsense reasoning.

Applying a length penalty during conditional text generation to match the average length of synthetic options to the ground truth, preventing language models from exploiting option length as a heuristic to guess the correct answer.
